name: returns no solution when local capacity is insufficient
input: only one undersized listing in the requested neighborhood
test:
listings = [{'id': 'a', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 3}]
snapshot = [listing.copy() for listing in listings]
assert select_group_listings(listings, 4, 'north') == []
assert listings == snapshot

name: minimizes capacity among feasible multi-listing subsets
test:
listings = [{'id': name, 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': capacity} for name, capacity in [('eight', 8), ('seven', 7), ('six', 6), ('four', 4)]]
snapshot = [listing.copy() for listing in listings]
assert select_group_listings(listings, 12, 'north') == ['eight', 'four']
assert listings == snapshot
